author: Karl Rock
description:
At a time when so much of the internet seems focused on mocking India, bands like @Bloodywood are showing the world a completely different side of the country.

What started as a metal band from New Delhi has become a global phenomenon. Bloodywood have toured across Europe, North America, Australia, and beyond, performing for hundreds of thousands of fans who sing along to lyrics in Hindi and Punjabi.

Their unique mix of heavy metal, Indian folk instruments, and powerful social messages has earned them a dedicated international following.

I've seen them live in Germany, Kazakhstan, and the U.S. and felt proud watching a crowd of 90% foreigners loving India culture. It's not something you see every day, and it's a reminder that Indian culture is reaching audiences all over the world in ways many people don't realise.

Whether you're a metal fan or not, it's hard not to feel proud seeing an Indian band succeed on the world stage while staying true to their roots.

Their rise is inspir
title: This Indian Band Is Huge Overseas
